As medical technologies continue to evolve, our products must operate seamlessly within broader healthcare ecosystems and enabling technology platforms. This leader will be responsible for defining and overseeing system-level architectures, ensuring robust integration across hardware, software, data, connectivity, and partner technologies. They will champion a systems-thinking approach, proactively identify opportunities and risks, and ensuring our products deliver a seamless user experience while supporting the future needs of a connected healthcare environment. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with exceptional leadership, influencing stakeholders across functions, geographies, and organizational levels to bring complex systems and product visions to life. https://www.stryker.com/us/en/nse.html What You Will Do Lead system architecture, technical strategy, and integration activities for complex medical device products and platforms. Translate customer, clinical, and business needs into system-level requirements and drive alignment across software, electrical, and mechanical engineering teams. Lead requirements development, allocation, traceability, and verification planning throughout the product lifecycle. Drive system-level decision making, architecture reviews, tradeoff analyses, and risk assessments. Lead cross-functional product development efforts from concept through verification, ensuring delivery of safe, reliable, and high-quality solutions. Partner with Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, and Engineering stakeholders to ensure compliance with design controls and applicable standards. Identify, assess, and mitigate product development risks while promoting a risk-based development approach. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend new capabilities, platforms, and solutions that support future customer needs. Build alignment across global stakeholders and influence design direction without direct authority. What You Will Need (Required Qualifications) Bachelor’s degree in Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, Software, Biomedical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 8+ years of relevant engineering experience in product development, systems engineering, or technical leadership roles. Experience developing products within a regulated industry environment. Preferred Qualifications Medical device product development experience. Experience leading system architecture and integration activities for complex, multidisciplinary products. Knowledge of requirements management, verification, and system-level risk management. Experience with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, FDA Design Controls, or similar regulatory frameworks. Experience with requirements management tools such as Jama, DOORS, or Polarion. Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and SysML. Experience developing connected products, digital health solutions, or integrated healthcare technologies. Experience mentoring engineers and leading design efforts across cross-functional teams. $118,000 - $196,700 USD Annual Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program. Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD&D insurance, and short-term disability insurance. Stryker offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually. Depending on customer requirements employees and new hires in sales and field roles that require access to customer accounts as a function of the job may be required to obtain various vaccinations as an essential function of their role.

review_candidates.description: Company Description Nasr City for Trading and Contracting (NCTC) is a leading Egyptian company specializing in water and wastewater management solutions. The organization designs and constructs water and wastewater treatment plants, desalination facilities, and provides equipment supply and installation for pumping stations. NCTC also manufactures TMVT blowers and custom metalworks for water treatment projects, such as sedimentation tank bridges and grit removal systems. As the exclusive agent for several global technology providers, including Aeration Industries International, Kubota, RMU, Solid Water, Shanghai Kaiquan, and TMTV Industries, NCTC delivers innovative, sustainable solutions using the latest technologies. Its track record of successful projects contributes to advancing water management infrastructure and a more sustainable future. Role Description The Planning Manager – Water Treatment Projects is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt. This position is responsible for developing, maintaining, and monitoring project schedules for water and wastewater treatment plants, desalination facilities, and related infrastructure. Daily activities include coordinating with engineering, procurement, and construction teams; preparing and updating time schedules and resource plans; and analyzing project progress against milestones to identify risks and recommend corrective actions. The role involves preparing periodic progress reports, dashboards, and forecast analyses; ensuring alignment with contract requirements and project budgets; and supporting tender and proposal teams with planning data and time schedules. The Planning Manager also collaborates with stakeholders to optimize sequencing, improve efficiency, and ensure projects are delivered on time and in compliance with safety and quality standards. Qualifications Engineering degree (Civil or Mechanical) Strong project planning and scheduling skills, including proficiency with project management software (e.g., Primavera P6, MS Project) and development of baseline and updated schedules. Experience in water and wastewater treatment, desalination, or industrial infrastructure projects, with solid understanding of EPC project lifecycles and construction methodologies. Competence in data analysis and reporting, including progress measurement, critical path analysis, earned value concepts, and preparation of status reports and dashboards. Effective collaboration and communication skills for coordinating with multidisciplinary teams (engineering, procurement, construction, quality, and safety) and external stakeholders. Knowledge of contract management principles, including time-related clauses, claims support, and risk identification related to schedule and resources. Relevant academic background such as a bachelor’s degree in civil, mechanical, or environmental engineering, or a closely related field. Previous experience in a planning or project control role within construction or water treatment industries; experience in the Egyptian or regional market is an advantage. Strong organizational and time-management abilities, with attention to detail and capacity to handle multiple projects and deadlines. Proficiency in MS Office

review_candidates.description: About The Role Balfour Beatty has an exciting opportunity for a Package Manager to join our outstanding Major Projects team to work at our Old Oak Common development in London – join us and be part of the largest construction project in the UK . HS2s new c. 1 billion Old Oak Common station will become the UKs best-connected rail station once completed. Our Balfour Beatty VINCI SYTRA joint venture will be responsible for the final design, construction, and commissioning of the station in Northwest London. Upon completion, the new station will boast six underground platforms and up to eight platforms on the adjacent Great Western Main Line. Old Oak Common will also provide highspeed rail services to the Midlands, central London, Scotland, and the North, as well as direct services to three major airports. Incorporating passenger and retail facilities, the new station will provide an exceptional customer experience for both passengers and visitors to the station. What you'll be doing Health, Safety & Environment Promote and maintain a strong safety culture across all activities. Ensure compliance with HSE standards, including RAMS and SSOW for allocated works. Deliver daily safety briefings and support incident investigations. Drive environmental compliance and sustainable practices within the package scope. Subcontract & Interface Management Manage allocated subcontract packages, ensuring compliance with scope, programme, and safety requirements. Coordinate design and construction interfaces between subcontractors. Ensure subcontractor documentation and reporting meet project standards. Support readiness activities and escalate blockers to the On Site Logistics Manager. Programme & Production Develop and manage short- and medium-term programmes aligned with overall area and project schedules. Monitor progress, maintain accurate records, and apply short interval control techniques. Identify and mitigate sequencing conflicts within the package scope. Ensure subcontractor compliance with programme and productivity targets. Logistics Coordinate site logistics plans with the wider team and supply chain. Review and monitor subcontractor plans and logistics for plant, lifting operations, and resource allocation. Analyse package-specific logistical requirements and implement solutions. Resolve conflicts and ensure sequencing aligns with programme objectives. Quality & Technical Oversee technical delivery and quality assurance for allocated works. Manage NCRs Collaborate with design and quality teams to resolve technical issues and meet deadlines Who we're looking for BSc, MSc, or BEng level qualification in a Civil Engineering or equivalent GNVQ CSCS Ideally have experience within a related environment Eligibility to work and live in the UK SMSTS Good understanding of contracts and identifying notifiable events (NEC3). Good general construction experience on large infrastructure projects. Good awareness of procurement processes and level of detail in scope documents and WI Managing site activities & monitoring/reporting on subcontractors performance Experience in multidisciplinary interfaces environment Ability to report clear and reliable information Why work for us Day in, day out, our teams deliver some of the UK’s most ambitious, exciting and meaningful projects; developing, building and maintaining the vital infrastructure that supports national economies and strengthens communities. Why join us? Benefits As if contributing to and supporting work that makes life better for millions wasn’t rewarding enough, we offer a full range of benefits too. You’ll have the freedom to shape the package that’s right for you and your life. Here are some of our key benefits: Smart working, giving you more flexibility such as staggered start and finish times, with up to 40% remote working, where roles allow. 25 days paid annual leave (pro rata) Family friendly policies which include 28 weeks full pay for maternity/adoption leave and four weeks full pay for paternity/partners leave Pension, share incentive plan, volunteering leave, recognition schemes and much more… About Us Balfour Beatty’s Major Projects business is delivering some of the UK’s most complex and iconic infrastructure projects including HS2, the new high-speed railway and the first nuclear power station in a generation, Hinkley Point C. Using the latest technology, we’re driving productivity and creating a lasting legacy by delivering sustainable solutions that strengthen communities. From consultancy and design, to all aspects of construction and maintenance. We have the proven expertise to deliver large-scale projects safely and successfully. Diversity and inclusion At Balfour Beatty we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential components of any successful, happy workplace. Through our Value Everyone Diversity and Inclusion Strategy and Action Plan, we are growing our diverse workforce and developing our inclusive culture where everyone is able to thrive and reach their full potential, regardless of their identity or background. To find out how we are making this a reality, visitwww.balfourbeatty.com/diversityandinclusion To help and support us with our desired commitment to create an inclusive culture we are members of WISE, enei, Business Disability Forum and the Association for Black and Minority Ethnic Engineers (AFBE). In 2020, we signed the Audeliss and Involve Open Letter to demonstrate our commitment to taking key long term and sustainable actions on Black Inclusion. Balfour Beatty is also a Gold Award holder in the Ministry of Defence 'Employer Recognition Scheme' and actively encourage applications from Armed Forces personnel, veterans and reservists. As a Disability Confident Employer, we are committed to working with people who have disabilities and long-term health conditions to remove barriers for them in obtaining employment. We are also committed to offering applicants with a disability an interview if they meet the minimum requirements for the role. For more info, visit: https://disabilityconfident.campaign.gov.uk/ We are looking to continually improve our resourcing process and ensure that it is fair and inclusive for all. Vi erbjuder lunchförmån och du får 300€ per år som du kan använda enligt dina önskemål för kultur-, välbefinnande-, sport- eller resebiljettförmåner. review_candidates.title: Médecin en soins intensifs (H/F) - Site Godinne
review_candidates.description: Depuis janvier 2016, Le CHU UCL Namur résulte de la fusion du CHU Dinant Godinne & de la Clinique et Maternité Sainte-Elisabeth de Namur et représente, grâce à ses 5035 travailleurs dont 500 médecins, le premier employeur privé de la Province de Namur. L’ambition de notre Institution est de former un ensemble hospitalier de référence au niveau national et européen, offrant des soins intégrés et de dimension universitaire à un niveau de qualité qui garantit l’attractivité des patients, des résidents et des meilleurs professionnels. L’équipe médicale des soins intensifs universitaires du site Godinne comprend actuellement 9 médecins (± 6 ETP) et une dizaine d’assistants (MSF et TPPSI). Le développement de l’équipe justifie l’engagement de plusieurs nouveaux collaborateurs. Le service est composé de 30 lits médico-chirurgicaux répartis sur quatre unités. Son Plateau Technique Particulièrement Performant Permet De Prendre En Charge Tous Types De Pathologies De L’adulte, Particulièrement Complexes, Tels Que Des soins post-opératoires lourds Chirurgie cardiaque et aortique Chirurgie thoracique et transplantation pulmonaire Chirurgie oncologique digestive (centre de référence œsophage et pancréas), urologique et laryngologique Neurochirurgie et polytraumatisés L’institution dispose de radiologie interventionnelle Des soins médicaux spécialisés Patients immunodéprimés, hématologie (JACIE, greffe de moelle) Cardiologie (angioplastie, rythmologie, clinique de l’insuffisance cardiaque…) Pneumologie dont pathologies interstitielles Gastroentérologie (développement d’un nouveau plateau technique) Infectiologie, collaboration étroite avec les USI Pour ce faire, le service dispose notamment d’un échocardiographe, de vidéo-endoscope, d’une scopie, de contre-pulsions intra-aortiques ainsi que d’ECMO, d’hémofiltration... Il gère les techniques d’épuration extrarénales et les cardioversions électriques réalisées dans l’hôpital. Responsabilités Prise en charge d’une unité de soins intensifs Supervision et enseignement des assistants (MSF et TPPSI) S’inscrire dans une démarche d’excellence clinique et de développement universitaire en participant à la recherche clinique et l’enseignement. Compétences requises Médecin porteur du titre professionnel particulier en soins intensifs Capacité de travailler en équipe multidisciplinaire Carrière académique incluant recherche, et dans un deuxième temps enseignement et service à la société Compétences relationnelles : écoute, flexibilité, dialogue Nous offrons Salarié(e) pour une carrière académique - clinique Temps plein Date d’entrée en fonction : dès que possible Renseignements Prof Philippe DUBOIS, Chef de département de médecine aigue phil.dubois@chuuclnamur.uclouvain.be 081/42.39.29

review_candidates.title: Mekanik Teknikeri/Teknisyeni
review_candidates.description: Biz Kimiz? CCN Holding, 3 ülkede 10 bine yakın çalışanıyla Sağlık, İnşaat, Yat, Teknoloji, Eğitim ve Turizm sektörlerinde 2007 yılından bugüne faaliyet gösteren bir grup şirketler topluluğudur. CCN Holding olarak geleceği şekillendirme hedefiyle ilerlemeye devam ediyoruz. Ve CCN Holding çalışanları olarak biz, Gücümüzü ekip olmaktan alıyor; geleceğe dokunan işlere birlikte imza atıyoruz. Sürekli gelişim odağıyla öğrenmekten heyecan duyuyor; ilerlemekten asla vazgeçmiyoruz. Yenilikçiliğe olan tutkumuzla hep daha iyisi için çabalıyor; farklı düşünüyor, fark yaratıyoruz. Doğru yapmak kadar doğru olanı yapmaya da odaklanıyor; iz bırakmayı hedefliyoruz. Sadece bugün değil gelecekte de var olmak üzere sürdürülebilirliği temel sorumluluğumuz olarak görüyor; daha fazlası için gönüllü oluyoruz. Önceliğimize hep insanı alarak hareket ediyor; her temasımızda değer katmayı amaçlıyoruz. Ve geleceği şekillendirmek üzere çıktığımız zirve yolculuğuna eşlik edecek yeni çalışma arkadaşları arıyoruz. Şirketimizin İstanbul Ataşehir Finans Merkezi projemizde görevlendirilmek üzere “Mekanik Teknikeri” arayışımız bulunmaktadır. Genel Nitelikler: Üniversitelerin Mekanik, Makine, İklimlendirme-Soğutma Teknolojisi gibi bölümleri ile ilgili ön lisans, meslek lisesi, lise veya dengi okul mezun (ilgili bölüme ait mesleki yeterlilik belgelerine sahip), En az 3 yıl AVM Hastane Havalimanı Otel Karma Yapı gibi işletme tecrübesi olan Mekanik arıza ve problemlerin tespiti ve giderilmesi konularında hızlı aksiyon alabilen, Isıtma soğutma havalandırma sıhhi tesisat konularında yetkin, Office ve ilgili disiplin programlarına hâkim, İş güvenliği ve işçi sağlığına önem veren, İstanbul Anadolu yakasında ikamet eden veya ulaşım sorunu olmayan, Vardiyalı ve esnek çalışma saatlerine uyabilen. · İş Tanımı: Tesislerin mekanik sistemlerinin ve ekipmanlarının sürekli çalışmasının sağlanmasından sorumlu olmak, Tesislerin bünyesinde çalışmakta olan mekanik ekipmanların programlarda öngörülen periyodik bakım ve onarımlarının yapılması ile arıza ve program dışı gerekli her türlü bakım onarım hizmetlerinin yapılmasını sağlamak, Tesislerin mekanik yönünden arızasız ve verimli çalışabilmesi için her türlü tedbiri almak, Tesis bakım onarım çalışmalarının 7/24 esasına uygun kesintisiz yapılmasını sağlamak, Üstlerine bilgi akışını gerekli raporlamalar ile sağlamak.

review_candidates.title: Medewerker Housekeeping
review_candidates.description: Loon: €2.400,00 - €3.500,00 per maand Rauw aan de kade, recht uit het hart, gelijk aan het werk :-) Voor ons Hotel Stay@Jumelet zijn wij op zoek naar echte powervrouwen, die hun handen uit de mouwen willen steken. Wat Je Echt Doet In Het Hotel Als je vroeg in de ochtend aankomt, begin je je dag om te kijken op je tablet wat er die dag gedaan moet worden. Daarna pak je alle benodigde spullen die je nodig hebt om aan de schoonmaak van de kamers te beginnen. Als je klaar bent om te beginnen, ga je met je collega's de hotel kamers schoonmaken. Een persoon, doet het bed opmaken, afnemen en stofzuigen, de andere de badkamer, toilet, douche en wastafel. Ondertussen ben je een echte duizendpoot, je gaat de hallen alvast stofzuigen, het linnen opruimt, voor jou is natuurlijk niks te gek en zie je altijd werk liggen. Ook draai jij je hand er niet voor om, om de gasten een warm welkom tussendoor te bieden en er een gezellige check in van te maken. 2 of 3 keer in de week wordt er schoon linnen geleverd, dit wordt in de linnenkasten gelegd, dit moet geregeld en gepland worden. Omdat jij oog hebt voor detail, zie je alles om je heen en ben je bereid je hiervoor in te zetten. Wat Je Echt Doet In De Shortstay Lekker op tijd op kantoor, dan pak je eerst een bakje koffie. Je overlegt met de leuke dames van kantoor, die je uitleggen wat je route wordt. Dan kijk je op je tablet, of alle besproken adressen erin staan Je pakt je spullen die je moet meenemen naar de shortstay huizen. Daar doe je de general cleaning, keuken, keukenkastjes, stofzuigen, dweilen, toilet, douche of eventueel de kamer schoonmaak. Als je daar klaar bent, kijk je weer op je tablet, naar de volgende locatie Wat Wij Vragen 38 uur per week beschikbaar ( ook in Weekenden) Je bent communicatief, gezellig, sterk en weet van aanpakken Je bent in staat om de dag om 7:30 te beginnen (ook in weekenden) Woonachtig in de regio IJmuiden Engels sprekend zijn een must Rijbewijs B Wat Wij Bieden Gezellige werksfeer Heb je goede ideeën, bespreek ze met je leidinggevende Je hebt de vrijheid om met je team er iets moois en leuks van te maken Ben je enthousiast, lichamelijk sterk en weet je van aanpakken, bel ons gelijk op +31 255 707 802

review_candidates.title: Mechanical Engineer
review_candidates.description: SnkeXR is a , open-platform augmented reality (AR) headset purpose-built for the medical industry. It is designed to facilitate and accelerate the adoption and integration of AR technologies into medical devices and workflows. With SnkeXR, medical device companies can develop and deploy customized applications directly on the glasses, or seamlessly connect their devices to enhance performance, functionality, and user experience. We’re looking for a mechanical engineer to design, develop, and test optical and optomechanical systems and components.   Responsibilities: ·      Mechanical design and development of multidisciplinary systems, with emphasis on optomechanics and thermal design. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of mechanical components with electro-optical systems. ·      Development of optomechanical mechanisms. Miniaturization, microintegration of components. ·      Prototyping and validation of innovative optomechanical concepts and performance testing. Conduct experiments and analysis of prototypes to evaluate and refine optomechanical functionality, performance and reliability. ·      Identify appropriate materials for optomechanical assemblies, considering factors such as strength, durability, weight, and heat dissipation. Evaluate and select suitable manufacturing processes, such as injection molding or CNC, to achieve cost-effective production while meeting quality requirements. ·      Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, safety regulations, and quality management systems. Follow regulatory requirement guidelines and ISO standards and incorporate them into the mechanical design and development process. ·      Prepare and maintain detailed mechanical design documentation, technical drawings, and specifications, design history files (DHF), and manufacturing instructions. ·      Collaborate with external suppliers and manufacturers to ensure quality and timely production of mechanical components. Support manufacturing processes, including design for manufacturability (DFM) considerations. ·      Stay updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in mechanical engineering relevant to state-of-the-art devices. Contribute to the innovation pipeline and propose ideas for product enhancement and future iterations. ·      Process test data, summarize and make clear reports and conclusions. Requirements: · Proven experience (over 7 years) in mechanical design and development. ·  Passion for rapid problem-solving and delivering solutions in very dynamic environment ·      Proficiency in CAD software (SolidWorks), GD&T. ·      Experience with miniature mechanisms and optomechanical design. ·      Matlab or Python scripting skills ·      Experience in prototyping, testing, and design verification methodologies. ·      Advantage: Experience in one or more: Heat management techniques CNC/molding/casting/3D printing technologies PCB/PCBA design
